trans-unit.source: The recycler allows you to select any deleted data and undelete it. You can undelete recursive if the parent of the element is deleted too.
trans-unit.target: The recycler lets you pick any yeeted data and un-yeet it. You can un-yeet recursively if the parent got yeeted too. Un-yeet game bussin!

trans-unit.source: Open context menu for multiselect options
trans-unit.target: Open context menu for multiselect options, fam

trans-unit.source: Permanently delete record "{0}" {1}? You cannot undo this action.
trans-unit.target: Permanently yeet record "{0}" {1}? No take-backs fam!

trans-unit.source: Permanently delete all the selected records (and any subpages)? You cannot undo this action.
trans-unit.target: Permanently yeet all selected records (and any subpages)? No take-backs bestie!

trans-unit.source: Permanently delete page "{0}" {1} and all of its contents (records and pages)? You cannot undo this action.
trans-unit.target: Permanently yeet page "{0}" {1} and all its contents (records and pages)? No take-backs fam!

trans-unit.source: Restore record "{0}" {1}? The record will be restored in its initial position and may become immediately active.
trans-unit.target: Un-yeet record "{0}" {1}? The record will respawn at its original spot and might go live immediately, ngl.

trans-unit.source: Restore page "{0}" {1}, its contents (and any subpages)? The pages and their content are restored to their original location and may become immediately visible online.
trans-unit.target: Un-yeet page "{0}" {1}, its contents (and any subpages)? Pages and content respawn at their original location and might go live immediately, no cap.

trans-unit.source: All parent pages have been restored to ensure a valid rootline.
trans-unit.target: All parent pages got un-yeeted to keep the rootline valid, bestie.

trans-unit.source: Restore all selected records and any subpages? All records are restored to their original position and may take effect immediately, including the pages and their content that may become visible online. Undoing this requires deleting each record individually.
trans-unit.target: Un-yeet all selected records and subpages? Everything respawns at its original position and might go live immediately. Un-doing this means yeeting each record one by one, ngl.
